retrieval_protocol: for each frozen quarter resource UUID, first request search=Sumatera Barat with length=0 to obtain post-search count and declared schema, then retrieve deterministic pages of at most 1000 rows until the exact count is reconstructed
zero_observed_row_rule: a quarter with an authoritative post-search count of zero may qualify as no_observed_sumbar_rows; it emits no numeric observation and is never converted to zero investment
row_period_validation_rule: every returned row must parse to its inventory year-quarter; any mismatch holds the entire quarter
province_validation_rule: every returned row must normalize exactly to Sumatera Barat; any global-search false positive holds the entire quarter
geography_mapping_rule: every nonempty returned row must map uniquely through explicit regency/city type plus the frozen BKPM geography contract; unknown labels hold the entire quarter
status_validation_rule: status_penanaman_modal must be PMA or PMDN; any other value holds the entire quarter
duplicate_dimension_rule: the complete 11-field source dimension tuple must be unique within each quarter; duplicates hold the quarter
missing_metric_rule: blank/null metrics remain missing; a geography-quarter-status metric sum is emitted only when all contributing source rows for that metric are non-missing
numeric_parse_rule: target values must be finite Decimal-compatible source values; signed negatives are retained and counted rather than clipped
full_history_success_rule: all 64 inventory quarters must complete transport/schema/count reconstruction and either have zero observed Sumbar rows or pass every row-level period/province/geography/status/duplicate validation; at least one qualified numeric geography-quarter-status observation must materialize
failure_rule: freeze every quarter result and fail reasons; do not silently drop failed quarters or broaden aliases without an explicit representation amendment
next_gate_if_success: install deterministic offline verifier, qualify quarter semantics for cross-quarter additivity separately, then merge M27 without creating annual or causal claims
next_gate_if_failure: amend only directly observed representation issues and rerun the same locked acquisition target
